**Running a short Flutter test**

I’ll set a timeout of 20 seconds using bash, but since I need a screenshot later, I need to be careful about how I approach this. arguments.command:
set -euo pipefail
LOG=/tmp/nothingness_seek_flutter.log
rm -f "$LOG"
flutter run -t dev/main_debug.dart -d linux --debug >"$LOG" 2>&1 &
PID=$!
# wait up to 60s for VM service line
BASE=""
for i in $(seq 1 60); do
  if grep -q "A Dart VM Service" "$LOG"; then
    BASE=$(grep -oE "http://127\.0\.0\.1:[0-9]+/[^ ]+" "$LOG" | tail -1 || true)
    if [[ -n "$BASE" ]]; then break; fi
  fi
  sleep 1
done
if [[ -z "$BASE" ]]; then
  echo "Failed to find VM service URL. Tail log:"
  tail -n 40 "$LOG" || true
  kill $PID || true
  exit 1
fi
echo "VM_BASE=$BASE"
# keep process alive for just a moment
sleep 2
kill $PID || true
